reference.name: iter10_estimator-swap-replace-the-singl_v1
reference.features: Gordon+HCP tangent concat + age/sex + L2 logistic (C=1e-2) + training-only threshold + label-free per-group calibration
reference.note: The loop starts from this model (neuroasd/model.py), tag iter10-loso-institution-v1 / PR #18. A trial wins only if it beats these numbers. Concatenation is not stacking. The original Gordon-only ridge baseline remains at tag linear-baseline-dcan-v1.

rule.note: Two bars, both either-split (one split gains the margin, the other drops at most regress_tolerance). ACCEPT: +0.3pp vs the current base (iter10, then the last accepted trial); the code becomes the new base. OPEN PR: an accepted trial that is also +1pp vs the last PR'd model (iter10 until the first PR), so small steps add up to a PR.

screen.rationale: Cheap filter on 6 mixed ABIDE I / II sites. The iter10 incumbent scores 0.731 here. 0.70 kills large regressions without requiring a new record on six sites.

loso-site.rationale: Must stay near the iter10 site-LOSO reference (0.728) before paying for the institution sweep. 0.71 is a filter, not the destination.

loso-institution.rationale: Accept as the new base if site or institution balanced accuracy gains >= 0.003 vs the current base and the other split drops by at most 0.005. Open a PR only when the accepted trial is also >= 0.01 above the last PR'd model (iter10-loso-institution-v1: site 0.7282 / institution 0.7084). Reproducing the base is not a win. Always report accuracy, AUC, ASD recall, and control recall.
